# Nais PostgresBackup reference

<!--
  This documentation was automatically generated by https://github.com/nais/pgrator/actions
  
  DO NOT MAKE MANUAL CHANGES TO THIS FILE, THEY WILL BE OVERWRITTEN!

!!! warning "Experimental feature"
    This feature is an alpha feature, and is subject to API change, instability or removal.
    See the [main Postgres page](../README.md) for more information.

This document describes all configuration values in the `PostgresBackup` spec. A `PostgresBackup` requests a standalone disaster-recovery backup of a `Postgres` in the same namespace and copies the base backup and required WAL segments into the team's DR bucket. Unlike the continuous point-in-time recovery window, a `PostgresBackup` has no owner reference to the source `Postgres` and survives deletion of the source database until `status.expiresAt` is reached or the `PostgresBackup` resource is deleted.
